iso_14687.source: ISO 14687:2019 Hydrogen fuel quality - Product specification, first edition 2019-11; Table 2 (grade D), Table 3 (grade E), Table 4 (grades A-C); text read from https://consultations.standards.govt.nz/draft-standards/hydrogen-standards-pc/user_uploads/dz-14687.pdf, accessed 2026-11-23

D.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I/II grade D (PEM fuel cell road vehicles)

E3.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade E category 3 (PEM stationary, gaseous hydrogen)

other.water: non-condensing at any ambient conditions (site specific, not evaluated)

B.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade B (Table 4, applications other than PEM fuel cells), used here as the industrial 99.9 % hydrogen specification

other.note: Only the hydrogen fuel index (99.90 %) and total gases (1000 umol/mol) are used. Per-species rows of Table 4 (N2 400, O2 100, total hydrocarbons 100 umol/mol and others) are printed in a column layout that the text extraction could not assign to a grade with certainty, so they are NOT applied and are listed as not evaluated.

A.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade A (Table 4, gaseous hydrogen for combustion engines and other non-PEM uses)

other.note: Combined water, oxygen, nitrogen and argon at most 1.9 % (19 000 umol/mol) per Table 4 footnote b; other rows not applied.
